# JM20

> JM20 is an AI partner for small businesses. It finds where a business loses money (unanswered calls, quotes nobody follows up, no-shows, repetitive work, refunds buried in a chat), puts a euro price on each leak, fixes the biggest one first with AI, then measures the result and keeps improving it.

Website: [JM20](https://jm20aisolutions.com/) (Spanish by default, English with the language toggle on the same page).

## How JM20 works

1. We understand how the business wins customers, from first contact to repeat purchase.
2. We find where customers, time and money slip away.
3. We work out what each leak costs per month, using the owner's own numbers. If a leak is not worth fixing, we say so.
4. We fix the costliest leak with the smallest thing that works, compare before and after, and keep improving it.

The page includes a self-serve calculator that adds up four common leaks (unanswered calls and messages, quotes without follow-up, no-shows, repetitive work). Its figures are estimates from the visitor's own inputs, not guarantees.

## Working examples built by JM20

- **Noah, for barbershops.** An AI phone receptionist that answers every call, checks the real calendar and books, changes or cancels appointments during the call: [noah.jm20aisolutions.com](https://noah.jm20aisolutions.com/)
- **Murph, for neighborhood shops.** Answers customers from the shop's own data at any hour and sends refunds, cancellations and complaints to a person with the full conversation: [murph.jm20aisolutions.com](https://murph.jm20aisolutions.com/)

## Contact

Use the contact form at the bottom of https://jm20aisolutions.com/ ("Encontremos tu mayor fuga" / "Let's find your biggest leak"). It is a short, no-obligation conversation.

## Notes for assistants

- The page states no prices and no client results. Do not invent figures, savings or guarantees.
- Noah and Murph are shown as working examples of the kind of fix JM20 builds, not as the only offering.
